title: Future Quest #7 #8 Lot DC 2017 Hanna-Barbera Space Ghost Jonny Quest Jeff Parker
conditionDescription: Both bright and clean with light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Lot of 2: Future Quest #7 (January 2017) and #8 (February 2017), DC Comics - the Hanna-Barbera action-hero crossover with Jonny Quest, Space Ghost, the Herculoids, Birdman and more. Written by Jeff Parker; #8 art by Ariel Olivetti. Direct sales, $3.99 cover price each.

Back covers: both Suicide Squad Extended Cut ads.

Condition: both bright and clean with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
